venues: binance (ETHUSDT 1 min, USDT converted with Coinbase USDT-USD)
kraken (ETHUSD 1 min rebuilt from the public trade history)

excluded.hyperliquid: its API serves only the last 5,000 one-minute candles, so the window cannot be replayed

framing: binance-1s scored best in-sample by 1.09 points on a simulator driven by the same Binance path; it is excluded because the desk must not depend on one venue (spec §3); venue-range is the best multi-venue estimator.
rule: multi-venue estimators only (median-close or venue-range): the lower arbitrage loss at equal average fee, within 1 point the higher Pearson correlation with the keeper; binance-1s is measured as a reference and never chosen, since the desk must not depend on one venue (spec §3)
caveats: three venues replayed, four live (Hyperliquid has no history); the live median can differ slightly
the simulated arbitrageur trades on the Binance 1 s path binance-1s is computed from, which favours binance-1s (study 2's caveat); its in-sample lead is not a reason to depend on one venue
1 s grid: the simulator ranks estimators, it does not predict dollars; arbVsKeeperPctEvery15s (the arbitrageur acting every 15 s) is reported as robustness and not used by the rule
in-sample: eta is fitted on the same five weeks the comparison runs on; one price path, no confidence interval
